channel.title: RSS Reader Changelog
channel.description: Release notes and product updates for RSS Reader.

item.title: RSS Reader 1.5
item.description: Sync with Feedbin, FreshRSS, Miniflux, and other RSS services. Follow sites that have no feed by watching their page for new links. Import your reading list from Pocket or Instapaper. Download podcast episodes for offline listening. Interactive widgets and a Control Center refresh control. Search your notes and highlights. Adapted for iPhone Duo. Optional iCloud Sync for feeds, reading state, Read Later, highlights, tags, and rules. Home Screen and Lock Screen widgets, a Share extension, and Dynamic Island controls for listening. Related stories by meaning, Time to Read, Links in This Story, and Quiet Hours. Smoother scrolling and lower battery use, more accurate ad filtering, and the app is now fully translated into 15 languages.

item.title: RSS Reader 1.0.0
item.description: Initial release with RSS, Atom, and JSON Feed subscriptions, OPML import and export, offline storage controls, notifications, and reader-focused article views.
